objective: Develop a bounded-memory causal local correction on E9/E10, then evaluate ONE selected policy on 14 outcome-unscored interval acquisitions.
exposure: E9/E10 response scores known; interval input prefixes and source metadata known. No interval predictive scores inspected before this protocol.
development: 48 binary files on four already examined days. These are development, never reclassified as untouched tests.
reserve: 14 interval files on distinct dates, disjoint from all E9/E10 dates. One date-conflicting record is quarantined, not scored; no date resolution invented.
prediction: E9 frozen history_input and history_no_input coefficients/cuts; no refit. Inherit horizons 5,10,20; offsets 0,1; target nuclear/image signal; five-minute origins; eligibility and 35/65 percent stages from E9.
feedback: At origin t, use ONLY base-model errors with target timestamp s+h<t, within the same cell. Inputs to base predictor include scheduled future pulses as in E9; this is input-conditioned prediction, not forecasting unknown future interventions.
candidates: 8: lookback 180 or 360 minutes x cell-only or nested x shrink 0.25 or 0.5. Up to 12 newest eligible non-overlapping forecast intervals, >=6; split chronologically into two blocks of >=3.
nesting: cell+pulse_band+TRAIN_value_band -> cell+pulse_band -> cell. Select most specific level with >=6 eligible errors. If sign or tail gate fails at that supported level, abstain; do not fall back to force a correction.
correction: Require means of older/recent blocks with same nonzero sign. c=shrink*sign(mean_recent)*min(abs(mean_older),abs(mean_recent)). Each block must have q95(abs(error-c))<=1.01*q95(abs(error)). Otherwise c=0.
meaning: Historical empirical admissibility only, not a valid interval for the future mean or a prospective no-harm guarantee. Nonoverlapping forecast intervals do not make cellular/history observations independent.
selection: Before reserve scoring: eligible if active on >=1% of late windows in EACH development day and mean context RMSE/base <=1.05 in EACH day. Rank eligible candidates lexicographically by worst-day mean supported pulse-band x value-band q95 harm fraction >1%, then equal-day mean of that fraction, then equal-day mean log RMSE/base, then candidate id. If none eligible, stop and retain reserve unscored.
comparisons: Same late support: base history_input, history_no_input, persistence, inherited fixed local guard, selected causal policy. All horizons/alignments retained. Feedback updates during late period use matured labels, never future labels.
gates: Whole archive hash; 62 full schemas; no duplicate track/time; stimulus consensus; frozen coefficient and policy hashes; independent reference checks on actual data; future-residual masking invariance; nonoverlap and maturation; model selection freeze before reserve; atomic metric and nested conservation; full remote custody.
locality: Parent, cell, pulse x TRAIN-signal intersections, three equal-duration late-origin segments, segment x pulse x signal. Preserve LOW_SUPPORT <20 windows; not an inferential sample-size guarantee.
uncertainty: Report acquisition-specific results and descriptive sensitivity thresholds 0,1,5 percent. Optional paired acquisition resampling uses observed data only and is labeled descriptive stability, never iid-window significance.
stop: No refit or selection changes after reserve outcomes; failures and abstentions retained. No FD7/FD8 intervention claim; no lab/contact.
